diagnostics.message: :module.forge_trust_validator_lambda: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_cloudwatch_log_group.forge_trust_validator_lambda is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.aws_cloudwatch_event_target.forge_trust_validator_lambda: explicit depends_on of :module.forge_trust_validator_lambda is redundant — already implied by attribute references
The module already references this log group through its logging_log_group input, so the explicit depends_on duplicates an implicit dependency.
The Lambda module's output reference in arn already establishes this dependency, making the explicit depends_on redundant.

The provisioner updates Forge role trust policies to name the Lambda execution role as a principal. That role must exist before the IAM trust-policy update, so this resource should wait for the Lambda module to finish creating it.

EventBridge needs the Lambda resource-based permission to invoke this function. The target should be created after the permission is installed; currently it only depends on the function module and rule, not on the permission.
